#### **[Allbirds Tree Runner](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462794367075260,imageDocid:1742178093591727560,gpcid:1258678313063907708,headlineOfferDocid:9247937047313140826,catalogid:16877564288258917918,productDocid:18278096094876073731,rds:PC_1258678313063907708%7CPROD_PC_1258678313063907708&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwixt_mX64OYAxUQTaQEHfGrDSEQxa4PeggIAggBCBcQAQ)** 

- **The Vibe:** Lightweight, silky, and sporty.
- **Best For:** Warm weather, long travel days, and high-humidity environments.
- **The Feel:** Made from renewable eucalyptus fiber, the upper has a cooler, mesh-like touch against the skin. It lets maximum airflow through, making it ideal when temperatures spike.
- **Pros:** Super breezy, quick-drying, great barefoot shoe for hot commutes.
- **Cons:** Less structured than wool; can show dirt or moisture more easily.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/fb-answers/allbirds-tree-runner-vs-wool-runner/)

#### **[Allbirds Wool Runner](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462900080128721,imageDocid:9833426660941872245,gpcid:1940523235698309983,headlineOfferDocid:2534751771319655779,catalogid:17921483593537784337,productDocid:11470254915862945935,rds:PC_1940523235698309983%7CPROD_PC_1940523235698309983&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwixt_mX64OYAxUQTaQEHfGrDSEQxa4PeggIAggBCBoQAQ)** 

- **The Vibe:** Plush, snug, and cozy.
- **Best For:** Fall/winter wear, casual office days, and cooler weather.
- **The Feel:** Crafted from soft ZQ-certified Merino wool, it hugs your foot with a soft, sockless-friendly interior. While wool sounds hot, Merino is naturally temperature-regulating, though it definitely retains more warmth than tree fiber.
- **Pros:** Naturally odor-resistant, cozy structure, flexes well in chilly weather.
- **Cons:** Not ideal for scorching summer heat or heavy rain/slush.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/fb-answers/allbirds-tree-runner-vs-wool-runner/)

To help narrow down the right pair, tell me:

- What **season or climate** will you be wearing them in most?
- Do you prefer a **breezy/mesh** feel or a **cozy/plush** feel?
- Will you typically wear them **with or without socks**?

I can give you a final recommendation and advice on sizing!
